requested_stages.name: LOCATE_AND_FREEZE_IDENTITY
permitted_operations: record size and modification time as metadata
read the first 100 SQLite header bytes
calculate the approved bounded ordered-chunk identity
inspect already-local backup and retention metadata

requested_stages.name: SQLITE_READ_ONLY_SAFETY_AND_CATALOG
permitted_operations: open exactly one SQLite URI connection with mode=ro
install a progress handler and per-statement deadline
read sqlite_schema and bounded pragma table/view/column/index metadata
inspect EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN for proposed later queries without running them
check before and after that no source-directory sidecar appeared

requested_stages.name: LOCAL_PROVENANCE_AND_RETENTION_INVENTORY
permitted_operations: inspect bounded local manifests, configuration, documentation and ingestion scripts
inventory retained raw-file names and existing metadata without opening market observations
record source report types, hashes, acquisition timestamps and methods when already documented
record parser versions, schema transitions, correction handling, vintages, backups and rights evidence

prohibited_operations: external network access or data acquisition
market outcomes, returns, features, signals, ranks or scores
strategy, hypothesis, sentiment or participant-positioning analysis
